crossRefs.note: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.
You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…
because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

translations.web: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
translations.bsb: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
translations.kjv: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
translations.asv: But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
